* <div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip">Existing users: Contact your account manager or customer support to increase quotas.</div>



Activate and configure BytePlus Messaging to send bulk SMS messages, while enabling real\-time tracking of delivery status. BytePlus Messaging supports multiple protocols including HTTP and HTTPS. The following flowchart outlines the HTTP/HTTPS protocol workflow for BytePlus Messaging:

Follow the steps below to activate BytePlus Messaging and start sending and receiving text messages.


1. **Sign up for BytePlus**: For more details, please see [Signing up for BytePlus accounts](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/byteplus-platform/docs/signing-up-your-account).

2. **Set up billing**: For more details, please see [Setting up billing](https://docs.byteplus.com/byteplus-platform/docs/setting-up-billing).


<div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip" data-tips-is-title="true">tip</div>


<div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip">If you want to pay offline, contact <a href="https://console.byteplus.com/workorder/create">customer support</a> for help.</div>



3. **Activate BytePlus Messaging**: For more details, please see [Activating Byteplus Messaging](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/byteplus-sms/docs-activating-byteplus-sms).

4.  **[Optional] Create message groups**: For more details, please see [Creating a message group](https://docs.byteplus.com/byteplus-sms/docs/creating-a-message-group).

5.  **[Optional, NOT needed for OpenAPI] Create SMS templates**: For more details, please see [Creating text message templates](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/byteplus-sms/docs/creating-signature-and-templates).

6. **Send bulk SMS via the console**: For more details, please see [Sending bulk text messages](https://docs.byteplus.com/byteplus-sms/docs/sending-bulk-text-messages).

7. **Integrate SDK/API for sending**: Integrate [BytePlus Messaging SDK](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/byteplus-sms/docs/sdk-integration_1) or use [API for messaging](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/docs/byteplus-sms/docs-overview) to send messages.

8. **Track the delivery status**: For more details, please see [Enabling webhook](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/byteplus-sms/docs/receiving-mobile-originated-messages) and [Webhook](https://docs.byteplus.com/en/byteplus-sms/docs/receiving-delivery-receipts).
